Use case: precise-object-edit. One 1254x1254 transparent RGBA full-body sprite, WEST hit frame03/06. Image 1 is edit target, image2 is WEST orientation reference, image3 is approved PRIMARY hand-painted style.
Correct ONLY the near LEFT leg/ankle/boot direction in image1. This is the boot at the LOWER-RIGHT of the image, beneath the visible jade medallion. Its toe currently points at the viewer. Redraw that boot and the connecting short shin/ankle anatomically so its toe points screen LEFT, parallel in general direction to the other boot. We should see the near boot's outer left side and lateral gold trim, not a frontal triangular toe. Knee stays flexed; heel remains on screen-right side of that same planted footprint, toe extends to screen-left. Keep the foot-center anchor and ground height unchanged; two feet remain apart, not overlapped. Keep distinct correct knee -> shin -> ankle -> boot connection.
Preserve EVERYTHING else exactly: full canvas/head/body scale and location, face still screen LEFT, recoil tilt, pained eyes, both arms, far RIGHT fan grip, near LEFT empty hand extended screen-right, visible LEFT hip jade, open ivory-blue dragon fan, costume motifs, hair ornaments, sleeves and tassels. Do not mirror, swap hands, change silhouette elsewhere, zoom, recenter, add effects/text/ground/shadow. Real alpha background.
